metadata.title: European Union Policy Areas Directory
metadata.description: The EU organizes its work across 33 distinct policy areas, each managed through dedicated directorates-general and supported by specialized agencies.
metadata.notes: According to EUR-Lex, EU legislation is grouped into 32 policy fields, with cross-cutting initiatives like the European Green Deal spanning multiple domains.
